as_told.title: UFO Sky Pods: 36 people who say they flew the craft

plain: Thirty-six people, each on their own, came to the UFO researcher and author Grant Cameron and told him the same thing: "I've flown the craft." Cameron tells Michels that he wrote a whole book about them, UFO Sky Pods, and says they came to him "mysteriously". If true, it would mean humans have been piloting these craft themselves.
